label: Behavior
definition: An Act in which an Independent Continuant participates as an Agent in response to external or internal stimuli and following some pattern which is dependent upon some combination of that Independent Continuant's internal state and external conditions.
definition_enriched: A Behavior is an Act that an Independent Continuant participates in as an Agent in response to external or internal stimuli and following some pattern which is dependent upon some combination of that Independent Continuant's internal state and external conditions.

label: Increase of Disposition
definition: An Increase of Realizable Entity in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Disposition that it bears.
definition_enriched: An Increase of Disposition is an Increase of Realizable Entity that is one in which some Independent Continuant has an increase of some Disposition that it bears.

label: Act of Manufacturing
definition: An Act of Material Artifact Processing wherein Material Artifacts are mass produced in a Facility for the purpose of being sold or distributed to consumers.
definition_enriched: An Act of Manufacturing is an Act of Material Artifact Processing that is one in which Material Artifacts are mass produced in a Facility for the purpose of being sold or distributed to consumers.

label: Act of Declarative Communication
definition: An Act of Communication that changes the reality in accord with the content of the declaration.
definition_enriched: An Act of Declarative Communication is an Act of Communication that changes the reality in accord with the content of the declaration.

label: Torque
definition: A Force that is applied to an object in a direction that would tend to cause the object to rotate around an Axis of Rotation and is the rate of change of an object's Angular Momentum.
definition_enriched: A Torque is a Force that is applied to an object in a direction that would tend to cause the object to rotate around an Axis of Rotation and is the rate of change of an object's Angular Momentum.

label: Act of Employment
definition: An Act of Association wherein an Agent assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.
definition_enriched: An Act of Employment is an Act of Association that an Agent assigns a set of activities to some Person to be performed in exchange for financial compensation.

label: Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact
definition: An Act of Communication in which technology is used to create a new copy of the Information Content Entity in the recipient.
definition_enriched: An Act of Communication Mediated by Artifact is an Act of Communication that technology is used to create a new copy of the Information Content Entity in the recipient.

label: Act of Publishing
definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving the preparation and public issuance of information.
definition_enriched: An Act of Publishing is an act of mass media communication that involves the preparation and public issuance of information.

label: Act of Issuing
definition: An Act of Mass Media Communication involving sending forth, distributing, or putting into circulation some Information Content Entity.
definition_enriched: An Act of Issuing is an Act of Mass Media Communication that involves sending forth, distributing, or putting into circulation some Information Content Entity.

label: Act of Refrain
definition: A Planned Act in which some Agent avoids or stops themselves from participating in some Planned Act.
definition_enriched: An Act of Refrain is a Planned Act that involves some Agent avoiding or stopping themselves from participating in some Planned Act.

label: Act of Censuring
definition: An Act of Expressive Communication performed by expressing strong disapproval or criticism.
definition_enriched: An Act of Censuring is an Act of Expressive Communication that is performed by expressing strong disapproval or criticism.
